title: 충청북도 진천군과 음성군의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 충청북도 진천군과 음성군의 관할구역 변경에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 2 (Areas Incorporated into the Jurisdiction of Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do)
(1) The following parcels of land in Duta-ri, Deoksan-myeon, Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do: Lot 112-6, Lot 112-7, Lot 113-5, Lot 113-6, Lot 114-2, Lot 114-4, Lot 114-6, Lots 114-9 through 114-11, Lots 115-1 through 115-3, Lot 116-1, Lot 116-4, Lot 116-5, Lot 116-7, Lot 117-11, Lot 465-35, and Mountain Lots 33-9 through 33-11.
(2) The following parcels of land in Seokjang-ri, Deoksan-myeon, Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do: Lots 8-3 through 8-5, Lot 19-1, Lot 19-2, Lots 19-6 through 19-8, Lot 20-1, Lot 24-3, Lot 24-4, Lot 25, Lots 25-1 through 25-6, Lots 26-1 through 26-3, Lot 27-8, Lots 27-11 through 27-13, Lot 474-2, Lot 475-1, Mountain Lot 1-7, Mountain Lot 1-10, Mountain Lot 1-11, Mountain Lot 10-1, Mountain Lot 11-2, Mountain Lots 11-9 through 11-11, and Mountain Lots 11-13 through 11-15.
(3) The following parcels of land in Okdong-ri, Deoksan-myeon, Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do shall be excluded from the jurisdiction of Jincheon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do and incorporated into the jurisdiction of Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do: Lot 1-5, Mountain Lot 29-3, Mountain Lot 30-2, Mountain Lot 30-3, Mountain Lot 32-3, and Mountain Lot 32-4.
